standard.summary: sidecar 压缩编码。lz4fast=速度优先（默认），zstd1=压缩率优先，raw=不压缩，fast-cache=组合。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: The sidecar compression codec. lz4fast = speed first (the default), zstd1 = compression ratio first, raw = no compression, fast-cache = a combination.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.zstd1: Compresses smaller, heavier to encode and decode.

advanced_en.principle: Sidecar compression codec. lz4fast = speed-first (default); zstd1 = ratio-first; raw = no compression; fast-cache = combined.
